title: On the Geometry and Shapes of Rank 2 Log Unit Lattices
summary: Every number field canonically gives rise to two lattices: its ring of integers and its log unit lattice. While the shapes of the former have undergone extensive research, far less is known about the shapes of the latter, referred to as unit shapes. This paper presents an in-depth analysis of the unit shapes of number fields with unit rank 2.
